question: What GitHub-based growth loop did Ben Williams describe as part of Snyk’s product-led growth strategy?
expected_points: Snyk scanned connected GitHub repositories and created branded pull requests fixing vulnerabilities.
Other developers saw the pull requests, followed links to Snyk, and some signed up—bringing in new users.
evidence_quote: Snyk will scan their code, will find vulnerabilities, will automatically create Snyk-branded pull requests to fix those vulnerabilities.
